title: ControlledAppliance
description: Appliance controlled with a PAN device control.

isWaterHeater.description: True if the appliance is a water heater.

isPoolPumpSpaJacuzzi.description: True if the appliance is a pool, pump, spa or jacuzzi.

isInteriorLighting.description: True if the appliance is interior lighting.

isSimpleMiscLoad.description: True if the appliance is a simple miscellaneous load.

isSmartAppliance.description: True if the appliance is a smart appliance.

isManagedCommercialIndustrialLoad.description: True if the appliance is managed commercial or industrial load.

isStripAndBaseboardHeater.description: True if the appliance is a stip or baseboard heater.

isElectricVehicle.description: True if the appliance is an electric vehicle.

isIrrigationPump.description: True if the appliance is an irrigation pump.

isGenerationSystem.description: True if the appliance is a generation system.

isExteriorLighting.description: True if the appliance is exterior lighting.

isHvacCompressorOrFurnace.description: True if the appliance is HVAC compressor or furnace.
